esslImport.title: eSSL Attendance Import
esslImport.subtitle: Import monthly attendance and checkins from an eSSL report
esslImport.noAccess: You do not have permission to import attendance.
esslImport.instructions: Upload the monthly Detailed Work Duration .xls report, review employee matches, then validate before importing. Shifts come from ERPNext. Days without valid IN and OUT punches are skipped entirely.
esslImport.selectSource: Select a company and choose a report first.
esslImport.fileLimit: Choose a binary .xls report smaller than 5 MB.
esslImport.draftHint: Attendance is created as drafts by default. Submission requires permission and is disabled when Attendance has an approval workflow.
esslImport.running: Import {status}. This page updates when the background worker finishes.
esslImport.totals: {attendance} Attendance created · {created} Checkins created · {reused} Checkins reused · {skipped} days skipped · {failed} failed or invalid days
esslImport.mappingHint: Suggestions compare employee codes/numbers and exact names, never device IDs. Correct matches as needed; changes require a fresh preview.
esslImport.name: Report name
esslImport.previewTotals: {total} days · {eligible} to create · {skipped} skipped or unresolved
esslImport.blocked: Resolve employee mappings and errors, then validate again.
